title: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Saviour
description: Pass Me Not, O Gentle Saviour in Tonic Solfa: the solfa with the words, staff notation, all four verses with the refrain, and a piano.
about: Fanny Crosby wrote these words in 1868, and William Howard Doane wrote the tune for them in 1870.
underlay: Pass me not, O gen-tle Sa-viour, Hear my hum-ble cry; While on o-thers Thou art call-ing, Do not pass me by. Sa-viour, Sa_-viour, Hear my hum-ble cry; While on o-thers Thou art call-ing, Do not pass me by.

lines: Pass me not, O gentle Saviour,
While on others Thou art calling,

verses.label: Refrain
lines: While on others Thou art calling,
Let me at Thy throne of mercy
Thou the spring of all my comfort,
Whom have I on earth beside Thee?
